summary: Deterministic design, waveform, coverage, bit, entry, location and SVA evidence through the project-owned xverif MCP server.

upstream.sync_scope: Claude-facing skills and integration contract only; no xverif runtime or vendor dependency is vendored

mcp.routing: Call xverif_tools once, get the selected action schema, then use the managed session/query lifecycle; do not guess actions or silently switch backend, transport or data source.

requirements: A separately installed and licensed xverif checkout
Upstream xdebug currently documents V-2023.12-SP2 as its tested Verdi/NPI baseline; other releases require local compatibility validation
A separately installed and licensed Synopsys Verdi/NPI/FSDB or coverage runtime for vendor-backed operations
Project-owned MCP environment with XVERIF_HOME and any required license, Verdi and LSF variables
boundaries: The kit provides skills, documentation and a versioned contract; it does not launch EDA jobs itself.
The consumer project's .mcp.json owns the xverif command, paths, environment and backend choice.
Do not copy vendor headers, libraries, binaries, FSDB/VDB databases, credentials or license values into this repository.
Use xsimdebug only for an explicitly needed live simulator PTY; use xdebug/xverif MCP first when static or waveform evidence is sufficient.
